inherited_firebase_release_review.scope: Independent source review of the cloud service, additive rules and integrated account/session lifecycle; patched lifecycle rechecked at the exact app hash. The reviewer did not rerun the tests below.
inherited_firebase_release_review.legacy_workflow_continuity: Approved at rendered-dc1dfac91d99fa3fe475; all 101 inherited closed findings and evidence retain their original attribution and limits.

prose_review.scope: Final sign-in, saving, conflict and session labels and documentation checked against integrated renderShell, account/session code and every store status.

introduction_followup.scope: One Continue label and the new description-first procedure paragraph; frozen descriptions and questions untouched.

normal.skip_reason: The emulator suite is run separately with actual local Auth and Firestore.

checks: Unassigned, inactive, other-account, anonymous, unverified and non-Google identities rejected.
Allowed-kind lists are scoped; unrestricted and other-user queries rejected.
Current state and immutable history commit atomically; revision, metadata and deletion restrictions enforced.
Existing assignment and response authorization behavior unchanged.
Long native notes compress and roundtrip; stale revisions conflict; offline drafts retry.

browser_regression.scope: Real emulator-backed full 48-decision UI traversal, four final comparisons, offline Retry, both explicit conflict resolutions and sign-out/sign-in.

lifecycle_reproduction.expected_old_result: Fails: A stale resolution must not restore private session navigation after sign-out.
lifecycle_reproduction.instrumentation: The local test server exposes the actual store only to delay a completed real server resolution, then signs out before releasing the result. This handle is absent from published HTML.

checks: Only exact bill title, frozen short description and Continue are shown before coding; navigation cannot bypass the introduction.
An existing untouched model-revision-zero cloud session is acquired before Continue navigation, avoiding an artificial conflict.
Anonymous Continue followed by sign-in does not repeat the introduction or create a replacement session.
New sessions and reload before Continue show the description; Continue persists navigation without a judgment.
Reload, sign-out and sign-in preserve saved position without reapplying generated URL fragments.
Offline Retry, both explicit stale-revision resolutions and delayed completion after sign-out remain covered.

production_rules.method: Existing signed-in project-owner Firebase Console; no assignment changes.
production_rules.preservation: Removing only the new guided-review rules yields the previous complete rules byte for byte. No existing response documents were read, migrated, restored or deleted.

limits: Synthetic browser and emulator verification do not establish physical-device, screen-reader or human usability performance.
Live Google sign-in and a QA save after Pages deployment are recorded separately in deployment-verification.json.
Older browser-only sessions are not uploaded automatically; strict JSON import requires the exact same release.
